snapshot.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
snapshot.about: Bajaj Finance is mainly engaged in the business of lending. BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)

business_mix.what_it_does: Bajaj Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company engaged in lending, offering gold loans, MSME loans, two-wheeler financing, mortgages, and various other credit and financial products.
